decisions.reason: Removing quotation marks from one Mama's Hot Take section does not change the deferred paragraph-spacing or body-density requirements.
The candidate already has a message-154 MODIFY that records removal of the Mama's Hot Take outer quotation marks, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
The quotation-mark change concerns a Mama's Hot Take section and does not alter Chapter 18 heading hierarchy, capitalization, or punctuation requirements.
The source decision changes text punctuation treatment, not image distortion, cropping, pixelation, or rendering quality.
Removing section-wide quotation marks does not change the justified body-text alignment requirement.
The quotation-mark treatment has no necessary effect on pagination or table-of-contents page-number requirements.
The textual punctuation correction does not change the paperback format or 6 x 9 inch trim size.
The source decision does not affect chapter-image coverage, placement, reference method, selection, or full-page presentation.
The specific quotation-mark correction does not change the candidate's general editorial goal or its existing sentence-clarity and meaning-preservation rules.
Quotation marks around a Mama's Hot Take section are unrelated to excluding the unintended newline-marker text from the book title.
The source decision does not alter image suitability, source, permitted generation method, tone, or colour-palette criteria.
The Mama's Hot Take quotation-mark correction does not change the copyright page's centre alignment.
